description: This Java class, ProtocolFactory, provides static helper methods for creating and manipulating protocol-related objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing TopicPaths, Payloads, Headers, and Adaptables, ensuring consistent object creation and parsing according to the Ditto protocol specifications.

classes.name: ProtocolFactory
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for creating and parsing protocol-related objects such as TopicPaths, Payloads, Headers, and Adaptables within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newAdaptableBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new AdaptableBuilder for a specified TopicPath or existing Adaptable.

methods.name: setExtra
methods.description: Returns a new Adaptable with an additional 'extra' field in its payload.

methods.name: newTopicPath
methods.description: Parses a string into a TopicPath object, handling path segments and exceptions.

methods.name: newPayload
methods.description: Creates a Payload object from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: newPayloadBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadBuilder, optionally with a specified JSON path.

methods.name: newHeadersWithDittoContentType
methods.description: Creates DittoHeaders with a specified headers map, including the Ditto protocol content type.

methods.name: wrapAsJsonifiableAdaptable
methods.description: Wraps an existing Adaptable as a JsonifiableAdaptable for JSON representation.
